version.changelog: Sync skill instructions, references, and helper from GitHub 902f58316c643ffbcabc57fc6f15f59d27ec063d

llm.summary: This skill is a narrowly scoped Apple jobs lookup helper that clearly uses Crawlora's external API and does not show hidden persistence, destructive behavior, or unrelated data access.

dimensions.detail: Network access to api.crawlora.net and use of the Crawlora API key are disclosed and proportionate to the API-query purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup only requires obtaining a Crawlora API key and setting CRAWLORA_API_KEY; no installer, dependency download, or system modification is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs agents to use a shell helper, but the helper fixes the API base URL and restricts requests to the two Apple Jobs routes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The helper creates a temporary curl config for the API key, tightens its permissions with chmod 600, and removes it on exit; no privilege escalation or persistent service is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to search public Apple careers listings and fetch posting details; the documented endpoints and helper script match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending Apple job search queries and job IDs, along with your Crawlora API key as an HTTP header, to Crawlora's API. Do not hardcode or commit the key.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Use of a shell helper is expected for this skill; while explicit allowed-tool metadata would improve packaging clarity, the script itself limits route scope.
[E1] expected: Requests to https://api.crawlora.net/api/v1 are disclosed in SKILL.md and endpoint reference, and are necessary for the advertised Crawlora-based Apple jobs lookup.
[PE2] expected: The flagged chmod 600 operation restricts permissions on a temporary curl config containing the API key; it is not sudo/root execution.
